controles.verbatim_source: Aucune mention d'une serie de hausses consecutives dans le 10-K FY2025, le 10-K FY2024 ou le 10-Q T1 2026. Le 10-K FY2025 ne dit que : "In February 2026, we announced a 1.3% increase in our quarterly cash dividend to $2.33 per share" et "following a 2.2% increase ... from $2.25 per share to $2.30 per share announced in February 2025". L'historique kpis-haut/HD.json ne remonte qu'a 2021 (6 hausses visibles).
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer le decompte, ou le remplacer par une donnee sourcee : 'dividende trimestriel releve de 1,3% a 2,33 $ en fevrier 2026, apres +2,2% en fevrier 2025' (10-K FY2025). Si le decompte est conserve, citer le communique investisseurs qui l'etablit et verifier le chiffre exact.

controles.affirmation: Apres l'annulation des droits IEEPA par la Cour supreme, aucun remboursement n'etait comptabilise au 3 mai 2026 et la societe juge le calendrier et le montant final incertains
controles.verbatim_source: "We continue to monitor developments with respect to tariffs and other trade policy matters closely, including impacts from the U.S. Supreme Court decision that struck down tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act ("IEEPA") ... We had not received any IEEPA tariff refunds pursuant to the U.S. Supreme Court ruling or recorded any such refunds in our financial statements as of May 3, 2026. Although an immaterial amount of these IEEPA tariff refunds has been received since the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2026, the timing of any further refunds and the total amount ultimately received or recorded remains uncertain." Les deux citations de l'ATT sont exactes.
controles.correction_proposee: Omission mineure a signaler : l'ATT ne reprend pas la phrase 'an immaterial amount of these IEEPA tariff refunds has been received since the end of the first quarter'. Elle est qualifiee d'immaterielle par la societe, mais son omission durcit legerement le propos.

controles.affirmation: Home Depot a subi des couts accrus lies aux droits de douane en 2025, compenses par la diversification et certaines hausses de prix
controles.verbatim_source: "we experienced increased costs as a result of tariffs in fiscal 2025" - present mot pour mot dans le 10-K FY2025, avec la mitigation via 'diversification efforts and some price increases'.

controles.affirmation: Rachats d'actions suspendus depuis mars 2024, pas de reprise prevue sur l'exercice 2026 pour reduire la dette
controles.verbatim_source: "In March 2024, we paused share repurchases in connection with the SRS acquisition and do not have plans to resume share repurchases in fiscal 2026 as we seek to reduce our outstanding debt" - present mot pour mot dans le 10-Q T1 2026.

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle : 14,2% FY2023, 13,5% FY2024, 12,7% FY2025, 11,9% au T1 2026 contre 12,9% un an plus tot
SG&A a 18,6% du CA en FY2025 contre 17,4% en FY2023
En FY2025 le CA progresse de 5,2 Mds $ mais SRS et GMS apportent environ 6,3 Mds $ de ventes incrementales ; comparable FY2025 +0,3% apres deux annees negatives
controles.verbatim_source: "Net sales for fiscal 2025 increased $5.2 billion, or 3.2%, to $164.7 billion ... In aggregate, these acquisitions contributed approximately $6.3 billion of incremental net sales during fiscal 2025". Comparable sales : "0.3 % (1.8) % (3.2) %" pour FY2025, FY2024, FY2023.

controles.affirmation: L'exercice FY2024 comptait une 53e semaine, environ 2,5 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2024 (HD_2025-03-21) : "incremental net sales of approximately $2.5 billion attributable to the additional week in fiscal 2024". Le 10-K FY2025 ne quantifie la 53e semaine qu'en BPA (+0,30 $).

controles.affirmation: T1 2026 : +4,8% de CA dont 1,3 Md $ venant de GMS, ventes comparables +0,6% dont environ 55 points de base d'effet de change
controles.verbatim_source: "Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 were $41.8 billion, an increase of 4.8% ... GMS, which was acquired on September 4, 2025 and contributed $1.3 billion of net sales" ; "Total comparable sales ... increased 0.6% ... Foreign exchange rates positively impacted comparable sales by approximately 55 basis points".

controles.affirmation: Transactions comparables -2,9% FY2023, -1,0% FY2024, -1,0% FY2025, -1,3% T1 2026 ; panier moyen +2,2% au T1 2026 ; quatrieme annee de repli du trafic
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "(1.0) % (1.0) % (2.9) %". 10-Q T1 2026 : "(1.3) %" transactions, "2.2 %" panier moyen. Le decompte 'quatrieme annee' est meme conservateur : le 10-K FY2024 montre FY2022 a (5.4) %, ce qui fait quatre exercices pleins consecutifs de repli (FY2022-FY2025).

controles.affirmation: Dette totale environ 53,5 Mds $ pour 13,9 Mds $ de capitaux propres et 1,6 Md $ de tresorerie au 3 mai 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q T1 2026 : short-term debt 3 503, current installments 5 178, long-term debt 44 828 (total 53 509 M$), equity 13 874, cash 1 601. Ratio dette/fonds propres = 3,86x.

controles.affirmation: ROIC passe de 31,3% a 25,4% en un an
controles.verbatim_source: "Our ROIC for the trailing twelve-month period was 25.4% at the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2026 and 31.3% at the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2025."

controles.affirmation: 23,5 Mds $ d'acquisitions : SRS 18,0 Mds $ en juin 2024, GMS environ 5,5 Mds $ en septembre 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2024 : "the acquisition of SRS, with cash purchase consideration totaling $17.7 billion" ; total 18 028 M$ dans le 10-K FY2025. GMS : "approximately $5.5 billion, including the repayment of certain of GMS's outstanding debt". Somme = 23,5 Mds $.

controles.verbatim_source: "Net cash provided by operating activities 6,032 4,325" ; "Repayments of long-term debt (1,425) (1,106)" (10-Q T1 2026).

controles.verbatim_source: "continued macroeconomic uncertainties and other macroeconomic factors, including a persisting high interest rate environment, that continue to pressure broader home improvement demand" - present mot pour mot dans le 10-K FY2025.
